nodes.name: debug-bar.tsx
nodes.summary: Development performance overlay for the web app that renders live FPS, long-task, INP (event timing), route-transition, and JS-heap metrics using requestAnimationFrame sampling and PerformanceObserver, with threshold-based red highlighting and visibility-triggered start/stop.
nodes.languageNotes: Keeps render cost stable via capped sliding-window histories (pruneAndFindMax) and buffered PerformanceObserver entry types (longtask, event, measure); all observers and animation frames are torn down in onCleanup.

nodes.name: pruneAndFindMax
nodes.summary: Prunes sliding-window metric entries older than a cutoff timestamp and returns the maximum remaining value, keeping performance history bounded.

nodes.name: Cell
nodes.summary: Renders a single metrics cell in the debug bar with a label, formatted value, and red-highlight styling when the value crosses its threshold.

nodes.name: DebugBar
nodes.summary: Mounts the performance overlay: wires PerformanceObservers for longtask/event/measure entries, a requestAnimationFrame FPS loop, a heap-sampling interval, and visibility-based start/stop/reset, then renders the metric cells.

nodes.name: dialog-connect-provider.tsx
nodes.summary: Provider authentication wizard dialog implementing an API-key flow plus OAuth flows (manual code entry, prompted input forms, automatic callback) through a reducer-style state machine, driving the SDK's provider.auth, provider.oauth.authorize/callback, and auth.set endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Single large component with internal sub-views (MethodSelection, ApiAuthView, OAuthPromptsView, OAuthCodeView, OAuthAutoView) and a dispatch reducer; OAuth completion is deferred with setTimeout to enforce a minimum one-second spinner duration.

nodes.name: DialogConnectProvider
nodes.summary: Runs the full provider connection flow: loads auth methods, renders method selection plus API-key and OAuth views, executes authorize/callback SDK calls with a minimum-delay spinner, and dispatches reducer actions for completion, navigation, and errors.

nodes.name: dialog-custom-provider-form.ts
nodes.summary: Pure validation and row-factory module for the custom provider dialog: validateCustomProvider checks provider ID format, required fields, base URL scheme, {env:VAR} API-key references, duplicate models/headers, and collisions with existing providers, returning i18n-ready field errors plus normalized models/headers maps.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the project's pure-module pattern: takes state (plus a translator t()) as input and returns new output with no side effects, making it unit-testable without mocks.

nodes.name: validateCustomProvider
nodes.summary: Validates the custom provider form — ID pattern, name, base URL scheme, API key with optional {env:VAR} reference, per-row model and header duplicates, and provider ID collisions — and returns field errors alongside normalized models/headers records.

nodes.name: dialog-custom-provider.tsx
nodes.summary: Custom OpenAI-compatible provider creation dialog with dynamic model and header rows (add/remove via store produce), validation delegated to validateCustomProvider, and persistence through auth.set plus globalSync.updateConfig.

nodes.name: DialogCustomProvider
nodes.summary: Renders the custom provider form with editable model/header rows, runs validateCustomProvider on submit, writes the API key and provider config through the SDK, and reports success or validation errors via toasts.

nodes.name: dialog-edit-project.tsx
nodes.summary: Dialog for editing a project's display name, startup command, and icon, featuring drag-and-drop and file-picker image upload (readAsDataURL) and persistence via the SDK's project.update endpoint.

nodes.name: DialogEditProject
nodes.summary: Renders the project edit form with icon drop zone, name/startup-command fields, and a mutation that saves changes through project.update and refreshes the project icon in global sync state.

nodes.name: dialog-fork.tsx
nodes.summary: Session fork dialog that reconstructs prior prompts from the current session's message parts, lets the user pick a fork point, and creates a new session by base64-encoding the extracted prompt text into the session.create SDK call.

nodes.name: DialogFork
nodes.summary: Builds the fork-point list from session message parts (newest first), and on selection creates the forked session with the chosen base64-encoded prompt, updates the prompt context, and navigates to the new session.

nodes.name: dialog-manage-models.tsx
nodes.summary: Model management dialog listing all providers with per-provider visibility toggles that flip every model's visibility via local.model.setVisibility, ordered by popularity and with a shortcut into the provider-connect flow.

nodes.name: DialogManageModels
nodes.summary: Renders the provider list with master Switch toggles that set visibility for every model of a provider, ranks providers by popularity, and offers a button to open the provider selection dialog for connecting new providers.

nodes.name: dialog-release-notes.tsx
nodes.summary: Paged release-notes dialog stepping through highlight entries with keyboard navigation, a disable switch persisted via settings.general.setReleaseNotes, and page indicators.

nodes.name: DialogReleaseNotes
nodes.summary: Renders the paginated highlights carousel with next/close handlers, arrow-key and escape navigation, and a disable toggle that persists the release-notes preference before closing.

nodes.name: dialog-select-directory.tsx
nodes.summary: Cross-platform directory picker dialog: normalizes Windows/POSIX paths (drive roots, trailing slashes, tilde home aliases), lazily lists directories from the SDK file endpoint with caching, and fuzzy-searches scoped listings plus recent projects via fuzzysort.
nodes.languageNotes: A family of small pure path normalizers (rootOf, parentOf, modeOf, tildeOf, joinPath) handle Windows drive-letter roots and ~ aliases before matching; directory listings are fetched through useDirectorySearch, a custom hook wrapping createResource and the SDK file endpoint with a Map cache.

nodes.name: parentOf
nodes.summary: Computes the parent directory of a normalized path, preserving bare Windows drive roots when no further parent exists.

nodes.name: tildeOf
nodes.summary: Replaces the home-directory prefix of an absolute path with a tilde for compact display, matching case-insensitively.

nodes.name: toRow
nodes.summary: Builds a selectable List row for a directory, generating absolute, trailing-slash, tilde, and filename match variants so fuzzy search hits any form.

nodes.name: useDirectorySearch
nodes.summary: Custom search hook that scopes user input to a base directory, lazily loads directory listings from the SDK file endpoint with caching, and fuzzy-matches query segments against child directory names via fuzzysort.

nodes.name: DialogSelectDirectory
nodes.summary: Renders the directory picker dialog, merging fuzzy-matched directories, the home alias, and recent projects into one searchable List and resolving the selection through props.onSelect.

nodes.name: dialog-select-file.tsx
nodes.summary: Command-palette style switcher dialog that merges allowed slash-commands, open and recent file tabs, and cross-workspace sessions into one fuzzy-searchable grouped List with keyboard-driven open behavior.

nodes.name: uniqueEntries
nodes.summary: Deduplicates palette entries by id while preserving first-seen order.

nodes.name: createSessionEntry
nodes.summary: Maps a session record into a palette entry with a project-scoped label and relative timestamp for display in the session section.

nodes.name: createCommandEntries
nodes.summary: Filters the allowed slash-command options, pins common command IDs to the top, and returns ordered command palette entries with translated labels.

nodes.name: createFileEntries
nodes.summary: Builds recent and root file entries from opened tabs and the file tree state, deduplicating against already-open files for the palette's file section.

nodes.name: createSessionEntries
nodes.summary: Fetches sessions across all workspaces in parallel and converts them into grouped palette entries labeled by project and relative time.

nodes.name: DialogSelectFile
nodes.summary: Renders the unified command/file/session palette with grouped sections, live search over all entry sources, and selection handling that opens tabs, triggers command options, or navigates to sessions.

nodes.name: dialog-select-mcp.tsx
nodes.summary: MCP server management dialog listing configured servers with connect/disconnect mutations that refetch MCP query keys, plus per-server status labels and error details.

nodes.name: DialogSelectMcp
nodes.summary: Renders the alphabetized MCP server list with status/error display and buttons whose connect/disconnect mutations invalidate and refetch MCP queries on completion.

nodes.name: dialog-select-model-unpaid.tsx
nodes.summary: Upsell dialog shown when selecting a paid model without a connected provider: lists popular providers ranked by usage, allows switching to a free model, and deep-links into the provider connect flow via dynamic import.

nodes.name: DialogSelectModelUnpaid
nodes.summary: Renders the paid-model upsell list with provider tooltips and rankings, switches the active model on selection, and opens the connect-provider or provider-selection dialog lazily on demand.
